::: {.obsidian-terms-conditions}

Define the terms used in this document. Give each defined term its
own paragraph.

# Supply of services

State the basis on which the supplier provides the services. Cover
the standard of care, the personnel, and the subcontracting.

# Charges and payment

State the charges, the invoicing, and the payment terms.

# Liability

State the liability cap and the excluded losses.

# Confidentiality

State the confidentiality obligations of both parties.

# Data protection

State the data protection duties and the applicable law.

# Term and termination

State how the terms end and the consequences of termination.

# General

State the remaining boilerplate: notices, assignment, entire
agreement, and governing law.
